extracted.intended_audience: government personnel, regulated parties, and members of the public who prepare or rely on Federal Register notices (specifically CAS Board/OFPP stakeholders)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing or interpreting a Federal Register notice announcing Cost Accounting Standards Board meetings (agenda, dates, contact, and publication metadata). Applicable to OFPP/CAS staff, interested contractors, and public stakeholders who track or comment on CAS actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required notice headings (AGENCY, ACTION, SUMMARY, DATES, ADDRESSES, FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Headings may contain the following: the agency or agencies that issued and signed a document; the number of the CFR title and the number of each part the document amends, proposes to amend, or is directly related to; the agency docket number / agency internal file number; the RIN which identifies each regulatory action listed in the Unified Agenda of Federal Regulatory and Deregulatory Actions. (Also presented as the common Federal Register headings: AGENCY: ACTION: SUMMARY: DATES: ADDRESSES: FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT:.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These headings vary by document type. Use the Document Drafting Handbook for more details. The heading block (AGENCY/ACTION/etc.) is the standard structure for Federal Register notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include publication metadata (Document Citation, Document Number, Document Type, Page, Publication Date)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notice shows: Document Citation (e.g., 84 FR 64110); Document Number (e.g., 2019-25169); Document Type (e.g., Notice); Page; Publication Date (e.g., 11/20/2019).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete publication identifiers so readers can locate the official entry in the Federal Register and cite the notice accurately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the official PDF on govinfo.gov for the legal edition
rubrics_metrics.description: This document has been published in the Federal Register. Use the PDF linked in the document sidebar for the official electronic format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The XML rendition on FederalRegister.gov is informational; verify content against the official SGML/PDF on govinfo.gov when relying on the text for legal research or official purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public inspection statement and legal notice limitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Only official editions of the Federal Register provide legal notice of publication to the public and judicial notice to the courts under 44 U.S.C. 1503 & 1507.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If using public inspection listings for legal research, verify contents against the final, official edition. The XML-based FederalRegister.gov does not provide legal notice until ACFR grants it official status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory requirement to publish CAS Board meeting agendas (NDAA section 820)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 820 of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for FY 2017 requires the CAS Board to publish agendas of its meetings in the Federal Register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meeting notices should state that they are published pursuant to section 820 and should include the agendas for meetings (even if meetings are closed to the public) to satisfy the statutory publication requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meeting openness and comment availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The meetings are closed to the public. While CAS Board meetings are closed to the public, the Board welcomes comments and inquiries, which may be directed to the staff director using the contact information provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a meeting is closed, the notice should explicitly state that and provide a channel (contact person, phone, email) for public comments or inquiries for public awareness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT with complete contact details
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the staff director's name, telephone number, and email (example: Raymond Wong, Staff Director, Cost Accounting Standards Board (telephone: 202-395-6805; email: rwong@omb.eop.gov)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A named contact with phone and email enables stakeholders to submit comments, ask questions, or request further information referenced in the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include DATES and ADDRESSES (meeting date and physical location)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify meeting date(s) and physical address (example: Dates: November 21, 2019. Addresses: New Executive Office Building, 725 17th Street NW, Washington, DC 20503).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even where meetings are closed, provide the date and location for the record; this supports transparency and statutory compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agenda content should list specific topics and planned actions
rubrics_metrics.description: The agenda lists items the Board will discuss and planned actions, e.g.: (1) Conformance of Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) to GAAP including notices, ANPRMs, and SDPs on specific topics (revenue recognition, lease accounting, CAS 408, CAS 409, CAS 404, CAS 411); (2) CAS Board Annual Report for Fiscal Year 2019 and drafting actions in response to 41 U.S.C. 1501(e).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agendas should identify specific subjects, referenced standards (e.g., CAS numbers), and the kinds of documents or rulemaking actions being considered (notice addressing comments, ANPRM, SDP, annual reports). This level of specificity satisfies statutory publishing obligations and informs stakeholders of the Board's planned activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate document provenance and versions (Public Inspection, FR Doc. number, filing time)
rubrics_metrics.description: The notice includes a Public Inspection PDF reference (e.g., 'This PDF is FR Doc. 2019-25169 as it appeared on Public Inspection on 11/19/2019 at 8:45 am') and a filing timestamp ('Filed 11-19-19; 8:45 am').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the public inspection reference and filing information to help users reconcile public inspection drafts with the final published notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use FederalRegister.gov enhanced content notes appropriately
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhanced Content (navigational tools, table of contents, sharing, other formats like JSON, XML, MODS) is provided for convenience; the Table of Contents is a navigational tool that 'has no substantive legal effect.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include links to machine-readable formats (JSON, XML, MODS) and note when enhanced features (e.g., Public Comments widget, Regulations.gov data) are unavailable for a given document.
